thread:
nina: Quick sync — onboarding Rigel-21 weights to staging. Files at s3://models-prod/rigel21/v1/params.pth. Staging job failing with kernel/dtype errors and falling back to CPU. Can anyone take a look?

sam: Which image/version is staging running? Triton/CUDA mismatch often shows exactly that.

nina: Staging uses redwood/serving:stable-cuda12.4-triton2.14. Error in the logs: "no kernel found for aten::conv2d dtype=f16" — seems like kernels were built for 12.3.

phil: Yeah, ABI drift between 12.3->12.4 can surface per-kernel. We should avoid swapping the global stable if possible. Suggest a compat image (12.3 runtime) for Rigel canary.

ops-bot: CI action: queued job CI#1023 to build compat image redwood/serving:rigel-cuda12.3-compat-001. Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/1023 ETA ~30m :hourglass:

marco: One more head's up — local tokenizer smoke showed duplicate special tokens. Vocab contains both "<s>" and "<bos>" mapped to different ids. If tokenizer.add_bos=true we end up off-by-one on eval sequences. Temporary: set tokenizer.add_bos=false in the model config until vocab is cleaned.

nina: I'll open a hotfix PR to adjust the model config (set add_bos=false) and add a note to the model onboarding checklist. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/462

sam: For local perf testing try forcing kernel selector env var. Example:

```
ENGINE_KERNEL_SELECTOR=sm90,sm86 \
  docker run --gpus all -e ENGINE_KERNEL_SELECTOR=sm90,sm86 \
    -v /tmp/weights:/weights redwood/serving:rigel-cuda12.3-compat-001 \
    bin/serve --model /weights/rigel21 --smoke
```
Then run scripts/bench/quick_gen.sh --model rigel21 --len 128 --iters 5.

ops-bot: Build complete \u2705 image pushed: redwood/serving:rigel-cuda12.3-compat-001. Staging deploy started: slot-rigel-21-staging. Smoke tests: PASS. Deploy details: https://ci.redwood/deploys/1023

nina: Redeployed to staging and re-ran bench with ENGINE_KERNEL_SELECTOR=sm90. Latency dropped from ~380ms -> ~95ms for generate length=128. No CPU fallbacks anymore.

phil: I'll create INF-1130 with perf numbers, recommended kernel list (sm90,sm86), and an int8 quantization checklist for Dedicated customers.

marco: Vocab cleanup follow-up: I'll open infra PR to remove redundant <bos> token and regenerate merges/tokens. That will require re-fingerprinting and re-running the embeddings/unit tests.

nina: Summary/actions: 1) config hotfix (add_bos=false) merged via PR 462; 2) compat image built & deployed; 3) perf numbers logged and INF-1130 opened; 4) vocab cleanup PR pending (marco). Ping me if you need any extra perf traces or logs.

-- end of thread --
